summary.top_insight_title: Weak Positive Association: studytime and G3

key_insights.title: Weak Positive Association: studytime and G3
key_insights.insight: studytime and G3 demonstrate a statistically significant weak positive association in the analyzed data (Spearman rho = 0.105, p = 0.0367, n = 395). Higher observed values of studytime tend to correspond with higher observed values of G3.

evidence.comparison_summary: Original (Pearson and Spearman correlation): stat=0.1052, p=0.0367 (N=395). Re-investigation (Spearman rank correlation): stat=0.1052, p=0.0367 (N=395). Significance consistent: True.

limitations: Observational data only; established correlation does not imply causal relationship or direction.
key_insights.practical_implication: While statistically significant due to sample size, the empirical correlation magnitude is weak, indicating substantial variance remains unexplained.
